title: Fine Dining Bistro Floor
rules: Serve food from the left and clear from the right
Verify all guest dietary allergies prior to ringing order
Deliver hot dishes within 60 seconds of kitchen pass bell
assumptions: Active kitchen pass, POS order entry terminal, 4 dining tables with reserved parties

stations.name: Kitchen Pickup Pass
stations.description: Inspect and collect piping hot plated entrees.

stations.name: POS Terminal
stations.description: Enter table orders, special modifications, and allergy alerts.

stations.name: Table 2 (Window)
stations.description: Party of 4: Business lunch with shellfish allergy.

stations.name: Bussing & Glassware Station
stations.description: Tray staging, clean cutlery, and sparkling water carafe.

levels.title: Allergy Verification & Order Entry
levels.skill_name: Inquire, flag, and route dietary restrictions safely
levels.goal: Verify shellfish allergy at Table 2 and enter modified order into POS terminal with kitchen allergy alert
levels.instruction: Walk to Table 2 (Window), take the guest's order, then walk to the POS Terminal to enter the allergy alert.
customerProfiles: Guest with severe shellfish anaphylaxis dining with business associates
successConditions: Allergy recorded and highlighted in red on kitchen ticket
Verbal confirmation received from head chef
Table marked with allergen alert token
steps: Approach Table 2 with a warm professional greeting
Ask: 'Are there any allergies or dietary preferences we should accommodate today?'
Note severe shellfish allergy clearly on pad
Walk to POS Terminal and input order with SEVERE ALLERGY red modifier
checks: Allergy question asked prior to menu finalization

levels.title: Synchronized Hot Entrée Delivery
levels.skill_name: Deliver multi-plate courses simultaneously without food cooling
levels.goal: Pick up 2 hot main courses from kitchen pass and serve Table 1 from the left within 45 seconds
levels.instruction: Walk to Kitchen Pickup Pass, check temperature and garnishes, then deliver to Table 1 from the guest's left.
successConditions: Food served hot at table within 45 seconds of pickup
Plates placed from the guest's left side quietly
Entrées described accurately with sauce drizzle facing guest
steps: Hear pass bell and immediately approach Kitchen Pass
Inspect plate rim cleanliness and sauce placement
Balance plates and proceed smoothly to Table 1
Serve each guest from their left side, stating dish name
